comment_regular: For a TESObjectREFR whose base form is TESObjectLIGH, update both ordinary extra-light type 0x30 and spell-effect extra-light type 0x49 payloads from the same base LIGH data. The actor-owned transient LGHT payload uses the same type 0x49 storage but its parent base form is not TESObjectLIGH.
comment_repeatable: For a TESObjectREFR whose base form is TESObjectLIGH, update both ordinary ExtraLight type 0x30 and spell-effect ExtraLight type 0x49 payloads through the same native source-light state routine. Both calls pass optionalContext=null. Actor-owned transient spell-effect lights may share type 0x49 storage but are not converted into static caster admission.
